name: Living Towns
author: Jeffiest
description: The towns ask things of you after their houses are rebuilt. Each day the villagers post three bounties on the board (hunt in a dungeon, open its chests, go deeper, or bring them something), sized to how far your story has gone. A villager waits by the exit gate on a bounty's floors and pays you there. And the general stores stock better goods as each new dungeon is reached.
